acceptance.text: AC-1 GIVEN the tags `v1.9.0`, `v1.10.0-rc.1`, `nightly` and `1.10.0`, WHEN `release.Latest` runs, THEN it returns `1.10.0`.
AC-2 GIVEN only `v2.0.0-rc.1` and `v2.0.0-rc.2`, WHEN `release.Latest` runs, THEN it returns `v2.0.0-rc.2`.
AC-3 GIVEN no tag that parses, WHEN `release.Latest` runs, THEN it returns an error starting with `ERR_NO_RELEASE:`.

constraints: Bench fixture: L3 of the model bench ladder (F82) — several constraints in one task across two packages: a new package on top of an existing one, which must keep its behaviour.
`semver` exists and passes ALG-01; extend it (IsCandidate), do not rewrite its behaviour.
